signal: Linxup launched an AI-powered chatbot copilot for fleet managers in March 2026 and partnered with Applause in April 2026 to connect driver-safety data into technician scorecards for field-service fleets.

email.body1:
Hunter, saw Linxup launch its AI fleet copilot and the Applause partnership tying safety data into technician scorecards.

New product news like that usually means more small-business fleets are worth a conversation than any BDR can personally work, and good accounts slip before a follow-up lands. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Linxup off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Hunter, quick follow-up for Linxup.

With new AI and partnership stories live, more fleets are in-market than the team can touch, and most BDR orgs do not know how many meetings they actually need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and then it is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Linxup needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Hunter, last bit of proof for Linxup.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Linxup's reply rate likely compares to other fleet-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Hunter, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching a new AI product is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a fleet-tech motion? I will tailor it to Linxup either way.
